meta.description:
Welcome to the Official Little Bear YouTube channel! This is the ultimate destination for Little Bear fans. Catch up on all your favorite episodes and stay tuned for fun new clips and playlists.

SUBSCRIBE NOW to be the first to hear about new episodes and updates: http://goo.gl/RA601M

For more of your favorite shows and full episodes SUBSCRIBE to Treehouse Direct: http://goo.gl/IsTLa7
